scientific_question: Why does insurgent activity persist and reproduce along some connected geographic corridors rather than others?

mechanism_tests.required_signal: lower same-area renewal without a mechanically forced count change

mechanism_tests.intervention: hold strategic movement policy fixed or ablate conflict-responsive movement
mechanism_tests.required_signal: changed corridor activation with conserved force stocks

mechanism_tests.intervention: compare local manpower pooling with locality-shuffled pooling
mechanism_tests.required_signal: changed viable-locality reproduction without changing national recruited total

mechanism_tests.intervention: matched removal of external sanctuary access
mechanism_tests.required_signal: changed persistence near eligible borders with supply conservation intact
changed renewal and propagation beyond immediate engagement counts

recovery_gates.zero_propagation_recovery: homogeneous null near zero and spatial-frailty, degree-confounded, and serial-common-shock nulls collapse after their known synthetic confounders are controlled
recovery_gates.known_propagation_recovery: known propagation produces a positive adjacency effect, monotone neighbor-dose response, and stronger observed-topology signal than degree/stratum-preserving placebos
recovery_gates.hazard_or_R_I_relative_bias: <=0.10 where the true value is nonzero
recovery_gates.uncertainty: IID parent-episode bootstrap is never inferential; R_I inference requires a declared independent cluster field and at least two clusters
recovery_gates.administrative_censoring: no material bias after the declared censoring adjustment
recovery_gates.informative_censoring: must be corrected using known synthetic inclusion probabilities or fail closed
recovery_gates.multi_parent_mass: sum of parent attribution weights per child must be <=1 and known synthetic expected R_I must recover
recovery_gates.episode_censoring: duration summaries exclude left-censored initial and right-censored terminal episodes; repeated episodes retain distinct activation IDs
recovery_gates.mechanism_ablation: removing an absent path has no material effect and removing the sole active path eliminates its propagation signal

rules: Run first on synthetic worlds with known corridors and parentage.
Use matched seeds and preserve national force, population, and material accounting.
Treat same-area renewal and exposed-minus-unexposed neighbor activation as descriptive associations, never as proof of persistence or contagion.
Separate continuous episodes from extinction followed by reactivation.
Represent uncertain parentage with a child-to-parent edge table; never duplicate a child activation to encode several candidate parents.
Report gross R_I separately from net R_I that requires a prospectively fixed parent-child overlap interval.
Report movement, social, organizational-birth, and other parentage pathways separately before aggregating R_I.
Use cluster bootstrap or another dependence-aware interval across independent simulation runs; IID parent-episode bootstrap is descriptive only.
A causal spatial-propagation claim is blocked until the full zero-null, frailty, placebo, censoring, repeated-episode, competing-risk, and known-effect recovery battery passes.
Do not choose mechanisms or thresholds from Nepal or Afghanistan holdout improvement.
A general core change requires data-free or cross-case evidence and a superseding freeze.
